content: The R. Ḥurūf is a summary, introductory treatment of the premises of the science of letters: an introduction on the letter and three aṣls each with four vaṣls (written, spoken and mental-spiritual form of the letters), with an epilogue on the 'Doubled Seven'; the author distinguishes lettrists of practical application (ahl-i khavāṣṣ) from those of theory (ahl-i ḥaqāyiq) and devotes the treatise to the second.
